summary_1line: Dhritarashtra laments the inevitable destruction of the Kauravas, fearing Bhima’s fury and Arjuna’s unmatched prowess while recognizing fate and past mistakes.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima whirls his massive mace and crashes into ranks of elephants and chariots like a blazing force of destruction.
An enraged Bhima, eyes coppery and mouth licking its corners, charges roaring into the Kaurava army like an infuriated elephant through trees.
The blind king Dhritarashtra sits in despair while imagining Bhima and Arjuna burning through his armies like a wind‑driven fire through dry grass.
